name: Devyani International Ltd
title: Devyani International Ltd - 543330 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: QSR operator with KFC SSSG +4.9% and brand contribution up ~20%, but Pizza Hut SSSG -3.7% and net store closures in Q4 leave supply discipline and pricing unproven; no capex-per-store change guided.

triggers.label: KFC SSSG +4.9%, strongest in 14 quarters
triggers.quote: KFC delivered its strongest performance in the last 14 quarters, posting 4.9% positive SSSG and nearly 15% year -on-year growth during the quarter.

triggers.label: Q4 net store count negative; closures
triggers.quote: you have seen negative numbers in Q4, which is primarily because we are resetting our strategy from a BD perspective in terms of better -quality stores and a better pipeline.

triggers.label: Pizza Hut SSSG -3.7%
triggers.quote: While SSSG was at minus 3.7%, the SSSG performance improved on a sequential basis

triggers.label: Menu price change under 0.5pp
triggers.quote: on a portfolio basis, I would say it was maybe less than 0.5 percentage point.

guidance.quote: We expect to add approximately 200 to 225 net new stores in FY27 as DIL.
KFC is expected to contribute 100 to 110 stores of these additions

guidance.value: by end of current fiscal year
guidance.quote: We continue to expect completion of the merger by end of the current financial year.

red_flags.label: Pizza Hut SSSG negative, brand contribution slightly negative
red_flags.quote: Brand contribution for the quarter was slightly negative, primarily due to operating deleverage arising from lower same-store sales.

red_flags.label: Store closures; negative Q4 net adds
red_flags.quote: the focus, as you said, is to kind of shut the loss-making stores, which are there in the portfolio

red_flags.label: Debt up; temporary borrowing for Thailand equity
red_flags.quote: we raised some debt because there was some equity infusion required in Thailand

evasions.quote: If you can help me foresee the inflation in the near future, I will be able to tell you that.

evasions.topic: KFC SSSG drivers split (macro vs own initiatives)
evasions.quote: it is difficult to quantify factor by factor, as I have said in the past.
Mumbai question, you need to check with Sapphire.
